title: Pointwise work budget bound
statement: For all $n,k,b\in\mathbb{N}$, the total work budget with dyadic failure parameter $2^{-(b+1)}$ is at most $T_k W_k(n+1)^{\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+4}(b+1)$, where $T_k$ is the junta-tree call count and $W_k$ is the specified natural-number node-work coefficient.
